map.买看涨损益 = max(S − K, 0) − 权利金；卖看涨 = 权利金 −: Buy-call P&L = max(S − K, 0) − premium; sell-call = premium − max(S − K, 0); put options are symmetric
map.基于期权到期损益：买方最大亏损限于权利金、潜在收益大；卖方最大收益限于权利金、风: Based on option expiration P&L: buyer's max loss is limited to the premium with large upside; seller's max gain is limited to the premium with higher risk; the breakeven is strike ± premium, for option strategy evaluation.
map.预期标的价格上涨时买入看涨期权。付出权利金，获得以行权价买入标的的权利。上涨盈利: When the underlying is expected to rise, buy a call. Pay the premium for the right to buy at the strike. Upside is unlimited; downside is limited (at most the premium).
map.预期标的价格下跌时买入看跌期权。付出权利金，获得以行权价卖出标的的权利。下跌盈利: When the underlying is expected to fall, buy a put. Pay the premium for the right to sell at the strike. Downside gain is significant; upside loss is limited.
map.预期标的价格不涨或小幅下跌时卖出看涨期权。收取权利金，承担以行权价卖出标的的义务: When the underlying is expected not to rise or to dip slightly, sell a call. Collect the premium and take on the obligation to sell at the strike. Gain is limited (premium); loss is unlimited.
map.预期标的价格不跌或小幅上涨时卖出看跌期权。收取权利金，承担以行权价买入标的的义务: When the underlying is expected not to fall or to rise slightly, sell a put. Collect the premium and take on the obligation to buy at the strike. Gain is limited; loss is significant.
map.比较买方与卖方的风险收益特征: Compare the risk-return profiles of buyer and seller
map.按合约数与乘数折算实际金额: Convert to actual amounts by contract count and multiplier
map.点 = 100+5 = 105；到期标的 110 时每张盈利 5 元×乘数，低于: Point = 100+5 = 105; at expiration underlying 110, each contract gains 5 × multiplier; below 105 the max loss is the premium.
map.买方和卖方风险有何不同？: How do buyer and seller risks differ?
map.买方最大亏损为权利金，看涨收益理论上不封顶；卖方最大收益为权利金，但潜在亏损可能: Buyer's max loss is the premium and call upside is theoretically uncapped; seller's max gain is the premium but potential loss can be large.
map.看涨=行权价+权利金，看跌=行权价-权利金（不含手续费）；到期价只有越过平衡点才: Call = strike + premium, put = strike − premium (fees excluded); only when the expiration price crosses the breakeven is there a net profit.
map.对多张合约累计后不可忽略，尤其对接近平衡点的策略可能改变盈亏方向。: Accumulated across multiple contracts it is not negligible, and for strategies near breakeven it can flip the profit/loss direction.
